translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi touring censor Duan Hong said: "The bandits' ravages are at their height, yet Fu falsely claims the bandits are entirely eliminated and fraudulently received enfeoffment; if Fu is not punished there is no way to show admonition."

sentences.zh: 輔乃自陳戰閥，委其罪於守將歐信。

translations.literal: Fu thereupon personally declared his battle achievements, shifted his guilt onto defending general Ou Xin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fu then submitted a personal account of his battlefield record and shifted the blame onto the garrison commander Ou Xin.

sentences.zh: 帝皆弗問。

translations.literal: The emperor all did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor declined to investigate either matter.

sentences.zh: 三年總兵征迤東，與都御史李秉從撫順深入，邊戰有功，進侯。

translations.literal: In the third year as regional commander campaigned to Liaodong, together with censor-in-chief Li Bing followed from Fushun deep inward, along the way fought with merit, promoted to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he served as regional commander on a Liaodong campaign; advancing deep into enemy territory from Fushun alongside Censor-in-Chief Li Bing, he won victories along the way and was promoted to marquis.

sentences.zh: 八年，廷議大舉搜河套，拜輔將軍，陜西、延綏、寧夏三鎮兵皆聽節制。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the court deliberated a major sweep of the Ordos Loop; Fu was appointed general; Shaanxi, Yansui, and Ningxia's three garrisons' troops all obeyed his command.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when the court resolved on a major campaign to sweep the Ordos Loop, Zhao Fu was appointed commanding general with authority over the troops of the Shaanxi, Yansui, and Ningxia garrisons.

sentences.zh: 輔至榆林，寇已深入大掠。

translations.literal: Fu reached Yulin; the invaders had already deeply entered and greatly plundered.
translations.idiomatic: By the time Zhao Fu reached Yulin, the raiders had already penetrated deep into the interior and carried out extensive looting.

sentences.zh: 輔不能制，與王越疏請罷兵。

translations.literal: Fu could not control [them], together with Wang Yue memorialized requesting to cease troops.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to bring the situation under control, Zhao Fu joined Wang Yue in memorializing to halt the campaign.

sentences.zh: 言官交論其罪。

translations.literal: Censorial officials jointly debated his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials submitted a wave of accusations against him.

sentences.zh: 命給事中郭鏜往勘，還言：「寇於六月入平涼、鞏昌、臨洮，殺掠人畜。

translations.literal: Ordered Supervising Secretary Guo Yong to go investigate, upon return said: "The invaders in the sixth month entered Pingliang, Gongchang, and Lintao, killing and plundering people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Guo Yong was dispatched to investigate and reported on his return: "In the sixth month the raiders entered Pingliang, Gongchang, and Lintao, killing and looting people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 迨七月而縱橫慶陽境內。

translations.literal: Reaching July and ranging freely within Qingyang's borders.
translations.idiomatic: By July they were ranging freely throughout Qingyang territory.

sentences.zh: 輔與越至榆林不進，宜治其弛兵玩寇罪。」

translations.literal: Fu and Yue reaching Yulin did not advance; they ought to be punished for the crimes of relaxing troops and treating invaders lightly."
translations.idiomatic: Yet Fu and Wang Yue, upon reaching Yulin, failed to advance; they should be punished for dereliction of military duty and negligence toward the enemy."

sentences.zh: 帝不納。

translations.literal: The emperor did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not accept the recommendation.

sentences.zh: 輔還，猶督京營。

translations.literal: Fu returned, still supervised the capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: After returning Zhao Fu continued to supervise the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 言者攻益力，詔姑置之。

translations.literal: Critics' attacks grew more forceful; edict temporarily set aside [the matter].
translations.idiomatic: His critics pressed their attacks more vigorously, but an edict ordered the matter set aside for the time being.

sentences.zh: 輔辭侯，乞世伯。

translations.literal: Fu declined the marquisate, begged for hereditary baron.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fu offered to resign his marquisate and requested instead a hereditary barony.

sentences.zh: 帝許其世伯，侯如故，僅減祿二百石。

translations.literal: The emperor permitted hereditary baron; the marquisate remained as before, only reducing stipend by two hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted him a hereditary barony while retaining his marquisate, reducing his stipend by only 200 shi.

sentences.zh: 言官力爭。

translations.literal: Censorial officials vigorously disputed.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials protested vigorously.

sentences.zh: 不聽。

translations.literal: [The emperor] did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused to heed them.

sentences.zh: 輔復上疏暴功，言減祿無以贍老。

translations.literal: Fu again submitted memorial exposing his achievements, saying reduction of stipend was insufficient to support old age.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fu submitted another memorial listing his achievements, complaining that the stipend reduction left him unable to support himself in old age.

sentences.zh: 又言上命內官盧永征南蠻，黃順、汪直征東北，皆莫大功，宜付史館。

translations.literal: Again saying the emperor ordered palace eunuchs Lu Yong to campaign against southern barbarians, Huang Shun and Wang Zhi to campaign against the northeast — all without great achievements; ought to be entrusted to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: He further argued that the eunuchs Lu Yong, dispatched against the southern tribes, and Huang Shun and Wang Zhi, sent to the northeast, had likewise achieved no great victories and that their records should be referred to the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 余子俊等請置輔於法，卒不問。

translations.literal: Yu Zijun and others requested placing Fu within the law; in the end not inquired.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zijun and others called for Zhao Fu to be prosecuted, but in the end he was not investigated.

sentences.zh: 十二年解營務。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year relieved of garrison duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was relieved of his garrison duties.

sentences.zh: 家居十年卒。

translations.literal: [He] resided at home ten years [then] died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in retirement for ten years before his death.

sentences.zh: 贈容國公，謚恭肅。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Duke of Rong, posthumous title Gongsu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously ennobled as Duke of Rong with the posthumous epithet Gongsu ("Respectful and Solemn").

sentences.zh: 輔少俊辯有才，善詞翰，多交文士，又好結權幸。

translations.literal: Fu in youth was handsome, eloquent, and talented, skilled in literary composition, had many literary scholar friends, again liked to ally with the powerful and favored.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fu was handsome and eloquent in his youth, skilled in literary composition, cultivated many scholarly friendships, and was fond of currying favor with those in power.

sentences.zh: 故屢遭論劾，卒無患。

translations.literal: Therefore repeatedly suffered criticism and impeachment, in the end without calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Hence he was repeatedly criticized and impeached, yet never suffered serious consequences.

sentences.zh: 子承慶嗣伯，協守南京。

translations.literal: His son Chengqing succeeded to the barony, assisted in defending Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chengqing inherited the barony and served in the joint defense of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 正德初，坐傳寫諫官劉郤疏，為劉瑾所惡，削半祿閑住。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengde, convicted for transcribing remonstrating official Liu Qie's memorial, was hated by Liu Jin, half stipend cut, idle residence.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhengde reign he was punished for transcribing a memorial by the remonstrance official Liu Qie, incurred the enmity of Liu Jin, and had his stipend halved while being placed in inactive retirement.

sentences.zh: 四傳至玄孫光遠，萬歷中鎮湖廣。

translations.literal: Passing down four generations to great-great-grandson Guangyuan, in the Wanli era garrisoned Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed down four generations to his great-great-grandson Guangyuan, who held command in Huguang during the Wanli reign.

sentences.zh: 明亡乃絕。

translations.literal: When Ming perished then ended.
translations.idiomatic: The lineage became extinct with the fall of the Ming dynasty.

sentences.zh: 劉聚者，太監永誠從子也。

translations.literal: Liu Ju was the nephew of the eunuch Yongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ju was the nephew of the eunuch Yongcheng.

sentences.zh: 為金吾指揮同知。

translations.literal: Served as assistant regional commander of the Jinyu Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He served as assistant regional commander of the Jinyu Guard.

sentences.zh: 以「奪門」功，進都指揮僉事，復超擢都督同知。

translations.literal: For the "Gate Seizure" achievement, promoted to vice regional commander, again supernally promoted to commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: For his role in the "Gate Seizure" coup he was promoted to vice regional commander and then abruptly elevated to commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 與討曹欽，進右都督。

translations.literal: [He] joined in campaigning against Cao Qin, promoted to right commissioner-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in suppressing Cao Qin and was promoted to right commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 成化六年，以右副總兵從朱永赴延綏，追賊黃草梁。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chenghua, as right deputy regional commander followed Zhu Yong to Yansui, pursued bandits at Huangcaoliang.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 6 he served as right deputy regional commander under Zhu Yong at Yansui, pursuing bandits at Huangcaoliang.

sentences.zh: 遇伏，鏖戰傷頦，麾下力捍以免。

translations.literal: Encountered ambush, fought fiercely wounded in the jaw, subordinates forcefully defended so as to escape harm.
translations.idiomatic: Ambushed in fierce fighting, he was wounded in the jaw but was saved by the strenuous defense of his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 頃復與都督範瑾等擊寇青草溝，敗之。

translations.literal: Shortly again together with commissioner-in-chief Fan Jin and others struck invaders at Qingcaogou, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he joined Commissioner-in-Chief Fan Jin and others in attacking the raiders at Qingcaogou and routed them.

sentences.zh: 永等追寇牛家寨，聚亦據南山力攻。

translations.literal: Yong and others pursued invaders to Niujiazhai; Ju also held South Mountain and forcefully attacked.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yong and others pursued the enemy to Niujiazhai, while Liu Ju pressed the attack from a position on South Mountain.

sentences.zh: 寇大敗，出境。

translations.literal: Invaders greatly defeated, exited the border.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders suffered a crushing defeat and fled beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 論功進左都督，以內援特封寧晉伯。

translations.literal: Assessing merit promoted to left commissioner-in-chief; because of inner-court backing specially enfeoffed as Marquis of Ningjin.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was promoted to left commissioner-in-chief and, owing to backing within the court, was specially enfeoffed as Marquis of Ningjin.

sentences.zh: 八年冬代趙輔為將軍，總陜西諸鎮兵。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighth year replaced Zhao Fu as general, commanded all Shaanxi garrisons' troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eighth year he replaced Zhao Fu as commanding general with authority over all the Shaanxi garrisons.

sentences.zh: 寇入花馬池，率副總兵孫鉞、遊擊將軍王璽等擊卻之。

translations.literal: Invaders entered Huamachi; [Ju] led deputy regional commander Sun Yue, mobile corps general Wang Xi and others to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: When raiders entered Huamachi, Liu Ju led Deputy Regional Commander Sun Yue, Mobile Corps General Wang Xi, and others to drive them back.

sentences.zh: 還至高家堡，寇復至，敗之。

translations.literal: Returned to Gaojiabao; invaders again arrived, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to Gaojiabao he encountered the raiders again and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 追奔至漫天嶺，伏起夾擊，又敗之。

translations.literal: Pursued the fleeing to Mantian Ridge; ambush arose pincer attack, again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the fleeing enemy to Mantian Ridge, he sprang an ambush in a pincer attack and routed them again.

sentences.zh: 鉞、璽亦別破賊於井油山。

translations.literal: Yue and Xi also separately broke bandits at Jingyoushan.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yue and Wang Xi also separately defeated the enemy at Jingyoushan.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，予世券。

translations.literal: Victory reported; granted hereditary certificate.
translations.idiomatic: When news of victory reached the throne, he was granted a hereditary certificate of investiture.

sentences.zh: 其冬，孛羅忽、滿都魯、乚加思蘭連兵深入，至秦州、安定、會寧諸州縣，縱橫數千里。

translations.literal: That winter, Boluo Hu, Mandulu, and Yijiasilan combined troops and deeply entered, reaching Qinzhou, Anding, Huining and various prefectures and counties, ranging freely for several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Boluo Hu, Mandulu, and Yijiasilan combined their forces in a deep raid reaching the prefectures and counties of Qinzhou, Anding, and Huining, ravaging an area spanning thousands of li.

sentences.zh: 賊退，適王越自紅鹽池還，妄以大捷聞，璽書嘉勞。

translations.literal: Bandits retreated; just as Wang Yue returned from Hongyanchi, falsely reported a great victory; imperial edict commended and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: After the raiders withdrew, Wang Yue, returning from Hongyanchi, falsely reported a great victory, and the emperor responded with an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 頃之，紀功兵部員外郎張謹劾聚及總兵官範瑾等六將殺被掠者，冒功。

translations.literal: Shortly after, Merit-Recording Ministry vice director Zhang Jin impeached Ju and regional commander Fan Jin and six other generals for killing those who had been plundered, fraudulently claiming merit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Merit-Recording Vice Director of the Ministry of War Zhang Jin impeached Liu Ju, Regional Commander Fan Jin, and five other generals for killing captives taken by the raiders and fraudulently claiming credit.

sentences.zh: 部科及御史交章劾。

translations.literal: Ministry bureaus and censorial officials submitted memorials jointly impeaching.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry departments and censorial officials submitted a barrage of joint impeachments.

sentences.zh: 詔遣給事中韓文往勘，還奏如謹言：所報首功百五十，僅十九級。

translations.literal: Edict dispatched Supervising Secretary Han Wen to go investigate, upon return memorialized as Zhang Jin said: reported severed heads of merit one hundred fifty, only nineteen grades [verified].
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dispatched Supervising Secretary Han Wen to investigate; on his return Han reported as Zhang Jin had alleged: of 150 severed heads reported as trophies of merit, only 19 were verified.

sentences.zh: 帝以寇既遁，置不問。

translations.literal: The emperor because the invaders had already fled, set aside without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Since the raiders had already fled, the emperor declined to pursue the matter.

sentences.zh: 聚尋卒。

translations.literal: Ju soon died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ju soon died.

sentences.zh: 贈侯，謚威勇。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted marquis, posthumous title Weiyong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously ennobled as marquis with the posthumous epithet Weiyong ("Formidable and Brave").

sentences.zh: 傳子祿及福，福，弘治中掌三千營，加太子太保。

translations.literal: Passed to sons Lu and Fu; Fu in the Hongzhi era managed the Three Thousand Camp, added Grand Guardian to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: The title passed to his sons Lu and Fu; Fu, during the Hongzhi reign, commanded the Three Thousand Camp and was promoted to Grand Guardian to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 卒，子嶽嗣。

translations.literal: [Fu] died; son Yue succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Upon his death his son Yue succeeded.

sentences.zh: 卒，從子文請嗣。

translations.literal: [Yue] died; cousin Wen requested to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: After Yue's death his cousin Wen petitioned to succeed to the title.

sentences.zh: 吏部言聚無大功，子孫不宜再襲。

translations.literal: Ministry of Personnel said Ju had no great merit; descendants ought not again to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel argued that Liu Ju had never achieved outstanding merit and that his descendants should not inherit the title again.

sentences.zh: 世宗不允，命文嗣。

translations.literal: Shizong did not assent, ordered Wen to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiajing Emperor overruled them and ordered Wen to succeed.

sentences.zh: 亦傳至明亡乃絕。

translations.literal: Also passed down until when Ming perished then ended.
translations.idiomatic: The line likewise continued until the fall of the Ming dynasty, when it became extinct.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：宋晟在太祖時，即與開國諸元勛參跡戎行，其後四鎮涼州，威著西鄙。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: Song Sheng in Taizu's time, then together with the founding great meritorious ones shared tracks on the military path; afterward four times garrisoned Liangzhou, prestige manifest in the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy states: Song Sheng, already serving alongside the founding meritorious lords under the founding emperor, later held the Liangzhou command four times, earning renown on the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 兩子尚主，世列徹侯，功名盛矣。

translations.literal: Two sons married imperial princesses, generation after generation ranked among full marquises; merit and fame were abundant indeed.
translations.idiomatic: With two sons marrying imperial princesses and the family ranking among full marquises for generations, their glory was truly magnificent.

sentences.zh: 薛祿以下諸人，皆與「靖難」。

translations.literal: The various persons from Xue Lu onward all participated in the "Pacification of Difficulties."
translations.idiomatic: From Xue Lu onward, all these men took part in the "Pacification of Difficulties" (the Yongle succession war).

sentences.zh: 祿東昌、滹沱之戰，劉榮守永平，譚廣守保定，宣力最著。

translations.literal: Lu [at] Dongchang and Hutuo battles, Liu Rong defended Yongping, Tan Guang defended Baoding — displayed their power most prominently.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Lu distinguished himself at the battles of Dongchang and the Hutuo River; Liu Rong held Yongping and Tan Guang held Baoding — each made outstanding contributions.

sentences.zh: 雖策勛之日，未即剖符，而各以積閥受封。

translations.literal: Although on the day of measuring merit they did not immediately receive tally-seals, each because of accumulated battle achievements received enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Though they did not receive enfeoffment immediately upon the initial reckoning of merit, each was eventually ennobled for his accumulated battlefield record.

sentences.zh: 其善撫士卒，慎固封守，恪謹奉職，有足尚者。

translations.literal: Their being good at soothing soldiers, cautiously securing frontier defense, scrupulously fulfilling office — there are things worthy of esteem.
translations.idiomatic: Their care for their troops, vigilance in frontier defense, and scrupulous devotion to duty are qualities worthy of admiration.

sentences.zh: 趙輔、劉聚猷績遠遜前人，而帶礪之盟，與國終始，誠厚幸哉。

translations.literal: Zhao Fu and Liu Ju's achievements and merit were far inferior to the earlier men, yet the covenant of girdle and whetstone, together with the state from beginning to end — truly great fortune indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fu and Liu Ju fell far short of their predecessors in achievement, yet they enjoyed the "covenant of the girdle and whetstone" and retained their honors until the dynasty's end — a mark of extraordinary good fortune indeed.

sentences.zh: 諸人並以勛爵鎮禦邊陲，故類著於篇。

translations.literal: These men all by merit enfeoffment garrisoned and defended the borderlands, therefore are collectively recorded in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: As all these men held ennobled commands on the frontier, they are grouped together in this chapter.
